description.narrative: (Rwanda): ..The Collaborating, Learning and Adapting (CLA) Activity will support.USAID by providing services designed to improve the application of monitoring,.evaluation and learning and CLA to achieve the development outcomes articulated.in USAID's 2020-2025 Country Development Cooperation Strategy. The activity.will provide expertise and on demand analytic support to the Mission to improve.the use of data and evaluations, by helping the Mission to synthesize,.visualize, and interpret data. The activity will also develop quality.evaluation designs, implement evaluations, and support the Mission to develop.post evaluation action plans. The CLA Activity will provide other supporting.services including facilitation services to be used for a variety of.collaboration purposes (such as activity reviews, activity learning and.collaboration, portfolio reviews, mid-course stock takings, design.consultations and events, etc.). .. ..The CLA Activity.enables USAID to be more thoughtful, evidence-based, and data-driven in its.activity designs, performance management, and collaboration across the.portfolio. .....
